jobs.description:
*Position Summary*

The Hospice Intake Coordinator is responsible for coordinating new patient referrals and supporting the admission process from initial referral through handoff to the clinical team. This role serves as a key point of contact for referral sources, patients, families, and healthcare professionals.

**Pay: $23/hour**

The ideal candidate is organized, compassionate, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities while ensuring referrals are processed accurately and promptly.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Receive, review, and process hospice patient referrals from hospitals, physicians, skilled nursing facilities, and other referral sources.
* Collect and verify patient information, medical records, referral documentation, and other required paperwork.
* Enter and maintain accurate patient information in the electronic medical record (EMR) and other systems.
* Communicate with referral sources, patients, families, and internal teams regarding referral status and next steps.
* Coordinate with clinical staff to support timely patient evaluations and admissions.
* Track pending referrals, follow up on missing documents, and communicate outstanding needs.
* Verify insurance information and assist with eligibility checks according to company procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements and company policies.
* Monitor referral activity and maintain accurate records, reports, and intake documentation.
* Escalate urgent referrals, incomplete documentation, and potential admission delays to the appropriate team members.
* Provide professional, compassionate service to patients and families during the referral process.

*Qualifications*

* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional healthcare education preferred.
* Previous experience in healthcare administration, medical records, patient intake, admissions, or referral coordination preferred.
* Hospice, home health, hospital, or skilled nursing facility experience is a plus.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling patient information.
* Ability to manage multiple referrals and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable using computers, electronic medical records, email, and Microsoft Office or similar tools.
* Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with clinical and administrative teams.

*Preferred Skills*

* Hospice referral and admission workflow knowledge.
* Experience verifying insurance information and coordinating medical documentation.
* Ability to prioritize urgent requests and follow up consistently.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a patient-centered approach.

*Success in This Role*

A successful Hospice Intake Coordinator processes referrals accurately and efficiently, communicates clearly with referral sources and internal teams, follows up on outstanding documentation, and helps ensure patients and families experience a smooth, compassionate transition into hospice care.

 **Requirements**  
  
Basic Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* At least 1 year of experience in healthcare administration, medical office support, patient intake, or a related role preferred.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic computer skills, including email, data entry, and Microsoft Office.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail when handling patient information and documentation.
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA requirements.
* Professional and compassionate communication with patients, families, and healthcare providers.

* Previous experience in hospice, home health, or healthcare admissions.

jobs.title: Materials Program Manager - (Temporary)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in a network of electric air taxis. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push onward toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service.

**Overview**
------------

In this role, you’ll own the creation and oversight of left-to-right clear to build schedules to support builds. As an MPM, you will oversee manufacturing operations (production, quality, material planning), cost, schedule, and deliverables during New Product Introduction (NPI), Ramp and Sustaining Phases as well as organize and oversee manufacturing (in-house or Contract Manufacturer) transition from validation to ramp and production states.

  

This is a temporary position for 4-6 months, based in Marina, CA.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Create and deploy supply requirements to the supply base via MRP which achieves production, inventory and cost objectives. Ensure demand from all sources (production, aftermarket, engineering, etc.) is supported appropriately

* Manage planning system parameters and master data to optimally reflect supply chain capabilities and plan supply. Deliver clear-to-build status, material coverage, run-out reports, and other analyses as needed to plan production and business targets. Provide data-driven decision support to the broader organization through what-if and scenario planning (as examples)

* Support onboarding and training of new suppliers to ensure operational excellence and compliance with Joby’s supply chain processes and policies

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or other related field, or equivalent experience

* Knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software, SAP enterprise system inventory management system such as SAP to Microsoft

--------------------------

This is a temporary role, anticipated to last 4-6 months. The target base pay for this position is $40 - $60 per hour.

jobs.description:
*The Supervisor for Integrated Behavioral Health Services provides operational leadership and frontline*

*management for integrated behavioral health clinicians embedded within pediatric medical specialty*

*services at UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals. This position is responsible for the daily operations,*

*workforce management, quality oversight, and program implementation supporting behavioral health*

*services across inpatient and outpatient pediatric specialty programs, including Hematology/Oncology and*

*other pediatric medical subspecialties.*

*Working in a highly matrixed environment, the supervisor partners with physician, nursing, operational, and*

*administrative leaders to ensure behavioral health services are seamlessly integrated into interdisciplinary*

*care delivery. The supervisor promotes excellence in patient- and family-centered care, advances equitable*

*access to behavioral health services, and supports strategic initiatives that improve clinical outcomes,*

*patient experience, workforce engagement, and operational performance.*

*The supervisor creates an environment that supports collaboration, continuous learning, innovation, diversity,*

*equity, inclusion, and belonging while fostering professional growth among behavioral health clinicians.*

**DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION:**

Integrated Behavioral Health (IBH) Services are part of the Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service

Line at UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals. The Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service Line brings

together inpatient, outpatient, consultation-liaison, and integrated behavioral health programs to create a

coordinated system of care that expands access, improves clinical outcomes, and advances the mental

health and well-being of children, adolescents, and families across UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals.

  

The IBH programs partner with pediatric medical and surgical specialty programs to provide integrated,

family-centered behavioral health care for children, adolescents, and young adults with acute and chronic

medical conditions.

  

Mental health clinicians are embedded within inpatient and outpatient specialty services—including Primary

Care and medical specialties—to address the psychological, emotional, developmental, and behavioral

needs of patients and families throughout the continuum of care. Working collaboratively with physicians,

nurses, social workers, child life specialists, rehabilitation providers, and other interdisciplinary team

members, the IBH program promotes early identification and intervention, improves access to behavioral

health services, strengthens care coordination, and supports positive health outcomes.

  

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

* Master's or doctoral degree in Psychology, Social Work, Marriage and Family Therapy, Counseling, or related behavioral health discipline.
* Current California licensure appropriate to discipline (Psychologist, LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated knowledge of integrated behavioral health models in inpatient and ambulatory care.
* Demonstrated supervisory skills to guide behavioral health providers on treatment methods for serious mental health disorders.
* Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and execute plans to meet deadlines.
* Organizational skills for coordinating staff schedules and unit operations.
* Ability to ensure patient care service standards are consistently met; assist staff with managing challenging patient interactions with sensitivity and skill.
* Experience providing a range of behavioral health services, including individual, family, crisis and brief therapy, behavioral health screening, crisis intervention, consultation, and care coordination.
* Experience providing evidence-based behavioral health assessment, diagnosis, and treatment in pediatric, medical, behavioral health, or integrated care settings.
* *At least two (2) years post-licensure clinical experience.*

**PREFERRED:**

* Knowledge of medical center, HR and UC policies and processes. Knowledge of relevant psychiatric health services internal policies and external regulations.
* Working knowledge of human resources management practices and policies.
* Knowledge of business software, specialized applications and EHR systems used in behavioral health clinics / clinical departments.
* Ability to perform all commonly applicable functions in word processing and spreadsheet software.
* Comprehensive knowledge of organization's patient record system to teach others.
  

**LICENSES AND/OR CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Current California licensure appropriate to discipline (Psychologist, LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, or

  equivalent).

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**

Symplify Roofing replaces roofs for Bay Area homeowners. We're a small, close-knit team and an Owens Corning Platinum Preferred Contractor. We've built our name on doing things right: clear communication, honest work, and treating every customer the way we'd want our own family treated.

**The role**

Every great small company has one person who holds it together. The paychecks are right. The books make sense. The files are where they should be. Customers get a warm, clear answer about their bill. That's this role.

You'll be the heart of our office, working closely with the founder on the business side of Symplify: payroll, commissions, receivables and payables, HR paperwork, and an office that runs smoothly.

We run on modern, cloud-based tools, including QuickBooks Online, Gusto, HubSpot, Google Workspace and Slack, and we keep adding better ones as we grow. You don't need to be an expert in all of them, but you should be comfortable picking up new software quickly.

**What you'll do**

* Run payroll and commissions, accurately and on time.
* Manage receivables: follow up on open invoices and help customers through payment.
* Review and pay vendor and subcontractor bills.
* Handle HR paperwork, from onboarding to employee files.
* Keep QuickBooks Online accurate and up to date.
* Stay close to our project team so you always know where things stand.
* Keep the office organized, stocked and running.

**Why you'll like it here**

* A positive team with good energy. We work hard, keep it light, and look out for each other.
* A new office in Walnut Creek, right next to BART, with free parking.
* Monday to Friday, daytime hours, weekends off.
* Modern tools, so you're not fighting old systems.
* Real ownership of your work and a direct line to the founder.
* 401(k) with company match, paid holidays and paid sick leave.

**You might be our person if**

* People describe you as steady, warm and trustworthy.
* You take quiet pride in work done right, even when no one is checking.
* You notice the small detail that doesn't add up, and you don't let it go.
* You can be kind on the phone and still clear about what's owed.
* You finish what you start, and you speak up early when something needs attention.
* You'd rather leave a place better than you found it.

**What you bring**

* Experience managing an office.
* Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience.
* Payroll experience, including commissions.
* Comfort with cloud-based software and a knack for learning new tools quickly.
* Discretion with confidential information.

**Nice to have**

* HR experience, ideally in California.
* Gusto experience.
* Construction or home services experience.

**Schedule**

Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., in our Walnut Creek office.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a few sentences on each:

1. Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it became a problem.

2. What does a well-run office feel like to you?

3. Tell us about a software tool you learned recently. How did you get up to speed?

Our process includes a conversation, an in-person interview with a short practical exercise, and reference checks.

Symplify Roofing is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the California Fair Chance Act. If you need an accommodation during hiring, tell us and we'll work with you.

Pay: $72,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

* Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it became a problem. How did you find it, and what did you do?
* What does a well-run office feel like to you?
* Tell us about a software tool you learned recently. How did you get up to speed?

WestCoast Children's Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. ***Working at WestCoast Children's Clinic means being part of an organization that is client-centered, trauma-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity.***

**Position Details**

**Title**: Case Manager and Engagement Specialist

**Classification**: Regular Full Time (1.0 FTE), Non-exempt (Hourly)

**Location**: Oakland, CA / Hybrid (availability to provide client services in-person and complete documentation remotely)

**Regular Work Schedule**: Full time, M-F

**Compensation:**

* $31.25 per hour ($34.37 per hour for qualified bilingual Spanish candidates)

The **Case Manager and Engagement Specialist** empowers foster and transition-age youth (TAY) through clinical case management and outreach across two core programs:

* **STAT (Screening, Stabilization and Transition):** Supports children and young adults (ages 0–21) as they navigate the profound emotional and life impacts of family separation and entering or changing foster care placement. Through mobile, trauma-informed screening, care coordination, and immediate stabilization, STAT ensures youth feel heard, safe, and supported during initial entry into child welfare and throughout placement changes.
* **Project AWOL:** Provides persistent outreach, trauma psychoeducation, and intensive case management to build trust and restore stability for youth experiencing placement disruptions or returning from missing status.

The Case Manager and Engagement Specialist makes a lasting impact by establishing trust with youth advocating for their safety, and connecting young people to mental healthcare, stable placements, education, legal support, and community networks. The Case Manager and Engagement Specialist ensures each youth has the resources and encouragement needed to heal and succeed.

**How the Case Manager and Engagement Specialist makes an impact:**

* Delivers individualized clinical case management, rehabilitation, and flexible care via community outreach and telehealth.
* Supports youth experiencing runaway behavior or placement disruptions, advocating for safe transitions into foster, relative, or group homes.
* Provides targeted early interventions to stabilize crises (STAT), address placement challenges, and maintain ongoing relational care (Project AWOL).
* Empowers youth to engage in care planning while connecting them to mental health services, mentorship, and vital community resources.
* Bridges service gaps for youth missing from care to address their physical, emotional, and safety needs.
* Assists youth with navigating Medi-Cal coverage to ensure continuous, uninterrupted healthcare and therapeutic support.
* Offers trauma psycho-education and advocacy to help youth process their experiences and build self-advocacy skills.
* Guides youth through delicate placement transitions with emotional and practical support.
* Maintains timely Medi-Cal/ACBHCS/DCFS compliance, meets service hour requirements, and completes ongoing professional training.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with systems involved youth (required).
* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Criminal Justice, Social Work, or a related field (preferred).
* Bilingual in English and Spanish (preferred).
* Experience providing case management and rehabilitation services.
* Demonstrated experience working with diverse adolescents with complex trauma, dual diagnosis, high mental health needs, or experience as sexually exploited minors.
* Knowledge of Alameda and SF County community resources for TAY youth.
* Experience delivering services in diverse community settings (homes, schools, neighborhoods, partner agencies).
* Ability to travel by car to meet with clients, generally within a 90 mile radius of WCC's Oakland office. Alternative forms of transportation may be accommodated based on the needs of the program and clients. Employees must have a clean CA DMV record. When driving for WCC, current vehicle insurance is required.

**Competencies:**

* **Case Management Skill -** Comprehensive assessment, crisis intervention, high-quality documentation, and ethical, legal practice while utilizing supervision effectively.
* **Cultural Humility -** Knowledge of issues of race, class and ethnicity.
* **Efficiency and Time Management -** Organized and able to prioritize tasks, manage complex caseloads, and meet deadlines efficiently.
* **Collaboration and Team Functioning -** Ability to work both independently and seamlessly within multidisciplinary teams to coordinate comprehensive client care.
* **Medi-Cal Billing & Compliance -** Proficient in, or ability to learn Medi-Cal reimbursement procedures, documentation standards, and billing practices.

The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

  

**About The Role**

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Operations Manager to join our Provider Core Ops, Systems Implementation (PCOSI) team to lead Product Implementation. In this role, you will manage the product implementation team, driving the operational execution, change management, and launch strategy for product features that impact Lyra’s full provider network and client base.

You will serve as the essential bridge translating clinical standards, service line goals and business growth targets into seamless product rollouts. You will manage a high-performing team and partner directly with Product, Engineering, Design, Clinical, and Service Line leaders. As our product surface area expands across complex program offerings and multi-channel launches,, you will evolve our implementation playbooks, resolve cross-functional roadblocks early, and ensure every product enhancement lands with high quality and operational integrity.

**Core Focus Areas**

* **Team Leadership & Inward Management:** Direct, mentor, and empower a high-performing team of Product Implementation leads and senior individual contributors.
* **Playbook Evolution & Scale:** Evolve legacy launch playbooks into sophisticated, repeatable frameworks built to handle exponentially increasing product complexity and rapid multi-channel rollouts.
* **Clinical & Product Integration:** Translate clinical and operational priorities into actionable technical product requirements while partnering with Systems Architecture to ensure backend Salesforce/EHR scaffolding supports user-facing capabilities.
* **Outward Influence & Strategic Alignment:** Drive cross-functional alignment across senior stakeholders in Tech, Product, Clinical, and Business teams to resolve competing priorities and clear execution roadblocks.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **People Management & Team Leadership:** Serve as direct people manager to the Product Implementation pillar within Provider Core Ops. Develop tactical team plans, delegate effectively, and invest in team culture, performance, and career development.
* **End-to-End Product Implementation:** Own the operational strategy and execution of product and policy changes across the full product lifecycle. Ensure internal provider and external client/partner audiences are enabled for success.
* **Cross-Functional Strategic Unblocking:** Act as the primary operational liaison to Product, Tech, and Clinical leadership. Poke holes early in product development, surface risk, reconcile program goals with macro business goals, and align competing stakeholder priorities.
* **Playbook Development & Continuous Improvement:** Evolve and maintain standardized product development and launch playbooks to support rapid platform growth across diverse service lines and provider network structures.
* **Systems & Product Synergy:** Work in tandem with the Systems Architecture pillar to ensure user-facing product features map seamlessly to underlying data infrastructure.
* **Change Management & Strategic Communications:** Oversee implementation comms and enablement strategies to ensure providers and clinical ops teams navigate platform shifts smoothly and feel supported in delivering care.

### **Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of professional experience in Product Operations, Clinical Operations, Program Management, Business Operations, or a related high-growth digital health/healthcare function.
* **People Leadership:** Proven track record as a direct people manager with demonstrated success setting operational roadmaps, delegating effectively, managing senior ICs, and mentoring team members.
* **Product & Systems Acumen:** Deep experience navigating the software development lifecycle, product rollouts, and tech stacks (Salesforce, EHR, Zendesk, Asana, Jira).

CareMind Health is a captive clinical services entity of Mindoula Health, Inc., and a national provider of virtual psychiatry and comprehensive behavioral health care services. We create access to convenient, high quality services delivered by compassionate and skilled clinicians. Our goal is to provide our clients with an exceptional experience that improves overall well-being, and restores the foundations of healthy living. We customize and scale these services to provide comprehensive behavioral health solutions for hospitals and other healthcare partners throughout the country. With expertise across the care continuum, we can not only fix pain points that many of our partners encounter - such as provider coverage gaps and ED throughput delays - but also solve complex problems that will improve patient experience, drive outcomes, and lower total cost of care.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Member Services (Knowledge Management)
jobs.description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Manager, Member Journey & Knowledge Management owns two primary outcomes: the health of the Member Services knowledge base, and a complete, accurate picture of the end-to-end member journey — its processes, policies, and pain points. The ability to own and influence both, are paramount to the role.

This role documents and maps how the member journey actually works today, keeps the knowledge base that describes it accurate and trustworthy, and uses both to identify where Product can meaningfully improve the member experience, from the perspective of efficiency/effectiveness as well as automation where possible.

This is a deep, focused ownership role. Success means the knowledge base is clean and trusted for both human and AI agents, the journey is fully mapped and understood end-to-end, and Product team has a clear, evidence-based view into where to invest next.

* Own the OneImaging knowledge base as the single source of truth.
* Own knowledge content lifecycle: identify and remediate outdated, duplicate, conflicting, or orphaned content.
* Establish and maintain the governance framework for content ownership, review cycles, approvals, and retirement.
* Define and maintain knowledge architecture: taxonomy, tagging, and organization to keep content findable.
* Monitor knowledge health: accuracy, freshness, duplication, content gaps, and search effectiveness.
* Ensure content is structured to support both human agents and AI-enabled support tools.
* Build reporting and dashboards that give leadership ongoing visibility into knowledge base health.

**End-to-End Member Journey Processes & Policies**

* Own documentation of the full member journey encompassing every process and policy a member touches from first contact through resolution.
* Partner with Business Owners and Product SMEs to validate that documented processes reflect actual practice.
* Ensure that when a process or policy changes, it's reflected consistently across all documentation and the knowledge base.
* Build and maintain visual, end-to-end process maps of the member journey across systems, teams, and handoffs.

**Product Enablement for Member Journey Improvement**

* Serve as the Member Services voice into Product: translate journey pain points, knowledge gaps, and operational friction into clear product opportunities.
* Analyze journey data, member feedback, and knowledge base usage to identify where product changes would most improve the member experience.
* Maintain visibility into upcoming product changes that affect the member journey and assess their downstream impact on processes and knowledge.
* Partner with Product to validate that shipped changes improve the member experience as intended.

**About you:**

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years in knowledge management, business process management, or journey/process mapping — preferably within Digital Health, Health Insurance, Radiology, or Tech-Enabled Healthcare Services.
* Proven experience owning a knowledge base end-to-end, including governance practices (ownership, review cycles, accuracy standards, retirement).
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining process maps (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro) for complex, cross-functional workflows.
* Experience partnering with Product teams to translate operational or process insights into clear requirements or opportunities.
* Comfortable working without direct reports — able to drive outcomes by influencing SMEs, Product, and Operations partners.
* Experience with knowledge base and CRM/support platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Notion).
* Highly self-directed, with the ability to build governance and mapping standards from first principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in radiology, medical imaging, or diagnostic services — clinical coordination, patient access, or operations.
* Familiarity with radiology workflows: prior authorization, imaging order management, payer-specific protocols, provider network coordination.
* Experience structuring knowledge content for AI-enabled support tools.

**Who You Are**

A systems thinker who instinctively maps how work actually flows before trying to fix it.

* Treats a messy knowledge base or an undocumented process as something to solve, not just flag.
* Keeps the member at the center of every process, policy, and product conversation — always asking "what does this feel like for the person on the other end?"
* Believes affordable, transparent healthcare access matters, and wants their work to be part of how OneImaging delivers on that promise.
* Data-driven but human-centered: uses journey and knowledge data to find problems, and judgment to prioritize fixes.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Points North is looking for a Senior Program Manager who is excited to support the way a growing, 60-person SaaS company gets its most important work done. This is not a PMO role where you install a methodology and police it. It is a hands-on role at a company that has grown on the strength of good people and good instincts and now needs just enough structure to keep that working as we take on bigger things: major product launches, company-wide initiatives, and a brand-new product experiment that needs an owner.

You will report to the VP of Engineering, but you will serve with the whole company. Product and Engineering, then Sales, Customer Success, Client Support, Implementation, Operations, Managed Services, Finance, Marketing, and People and Culture. You will be evolving program and project governance from close to zero, which means you get to decide what good looks like here, and you get to live with the results.

If you are the kind of person who believes the best process is the one nobody notices because it just works, who has seen heavyweight frameworks slow good teams down and has no interest in importing one, and who is as comfortable owning a product backlog as you are running a cross-functional launch, we want to talk to you.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Enhance lightweight program and project governance for Product and Engineering, and then for the company. Collaboratively structure and then document how work gets proposed, prioritized, tracked, and finished. Build the minimum that gives leaders the visibility and teams the clarity they need, and then defend that minimum against the natural pull toward more.
* Run our largest cross-functional initiatives end to end. Major product launches, operational improvement projects, and company-wide changes that touch every department. Own the plan, the dependencies, the risks, the communication, and the follow-through, so that the people doing the work know what they need to do and can focus on the work.
* Support the adoption of AI tools across the company. Not a mandate from above, but a real program: find where AI tooling makes people measurably more effective, help teams try it, learn what works, and spread it. Use AI yourself as a force multiplier in how you plan, communicate, and analyze.
* Be the Product Owner for an early-stage product experiment. We have one engineer dedicated to an early-stage internal tool that may have wider market opportunities. For at least the next six to twelve months, you will own the product side of that experiment: talk with internal and external stakeholders to vet which problems are worth solving, decide how to solve them and in what order, write clear requirements the engineer can build from, and build the evidence for whether there is a larger market. If it succeeds, we will hire a dedicated product manager to hand off to, and you will continue as our Senior Program Manager.
* Make priorities visible and tradeoffs explicit. Help leadership see what is in flight, what is competing for the same people, and what it costs to say yes to something new. Bring data and a point of view and let the executives make the call with clear information.
* Facilitate the Agile events and rituals that earn their keep. Planning, reviews, retrospectives, and the rhythms that keep teams aligned, tuned to what actually helps the team ship rather than what a framework prescribes.
* Build the operating cadence for the company. Quarterly planning, status reporting that people actually read, decision logs, and the handful of templates that make the next project easier than the last one. Document it well enough that it runs without you in the room.
* Partner with every function. Spend real time with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Implementation, Operations, Managed Services, Finance, Marketing, and People and Culture. Understand how each team works before suggesting how it could work better.
* Close the loop. When an initiative finishes, find out whether it delivered what it promised based on the metrics and success criteria established at kickoff. Run honest retrospectives and share what you learn to improve how we run the next one.
* Continuously learn and grow, in program management, in product thinking, and in how you help a company get better at getting things done.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* A practical thinker who knows the goal is a company that executes well, not a governance model for its own sake.
* A builder of just-enough process. Someone who has seen both ends of the spectrum, chaos and bureaucracy, and has a practiced instinct for the lightweight middle. You know that a process which is not followed is worse than no process at all.
* A practitioner of real Agile software development. You have worked inside teams that actually ship this way, and you understand the principles well enough to adapt the practices to the team instead of forcing the team to fit the practices.
* Someone with enough product instinct to own a product. You can sit with a customer, hear a problem underneath the request, decide what to build first, and write a requirement an engineer can act on without a meeting to decode it.
* A strong communicator who can brief an executive in two minutes, run a working session with a sales or operations team, and write a status update that people read all the way to the end. You follow up on your commitments and your questions.
* Someone who is enthusiastic about AI as an enabler, eager to experiment with AI-assisted tooling in your own work and to help others do the same, without abdicating judgment.
* A collaborator who earns trust across departments by being useful, not by holding authority. People should want you in the room because things go better when you are there.
* Someone who takes pride in enabling others and finds real satisfaction in a team finishing something big and knowing that your work under them made it easier.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in program m

We partner with health plans to provide a comprehensive suite of products and services designed to manage the total cost of care.

  

We are currently looking for a **Quality Assurance Analyst** to join our growing team!

  

**PURPOSE**

  

The Quality Assurance Specialist is accountable for and oversees the following tasks:

  

* Validate claims data against information from claims processing systems to ensure that data is accurate (for both auto adjudicated claims as well as manually processed claims)
* Analyze claims data against applicable policies and regulations to identify potential issues (e.g., member benefits, billing anomalies, payment accuracy, claims processing system issues)
* Review history of related claims to pull in and understand additional claims-related information
* Calculate dollar amount of financial claims errors/defects
* Develop and deliver fact-based audit determinations in an objective, non-confrontational manner
* Escalate issues identified during the audit cycle or rebuttal process to applicable stakeholders, as appropriate (e.g., Operations Team, Quality Team)
* Ensure compliance with applicable audit and rebuttal timelines (rebuttal timelines/form completion, workflows, turnaround time)
* Achieve production quality goals/metrics (e.g., audits per hour, audit accuracy, first-pass accuracy, rebuttal accuracy)
* Provide supporting documentation for audit findings

jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Mission:**

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

**Our People:**

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

**About the Role**

6sense is hiring a **Senior Digital Program Manager** to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform. Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

**What This Role Is – And Isn't**

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

* **You move fast and ship.** Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.
* **You lead, not just execute.** You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.
* **You flag blockers immediately.** Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.
* **You own your backlog.** You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.
* **You know the difference between "I need input" and "I need permission."** Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Program Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
* Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.
* Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.
* Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.
* Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

**Digital Journey & Campaign Build**

* Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.
* Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.
* Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.
* A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

**Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis**

* Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.
* Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.
* Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

**Gainsight Platform** **Leader**

* Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.
* Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs
* Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

**Reporting, Analytics & Insights**

* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership
* Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.
* Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

**CS Ops & Leadership Partnership**

* Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.
* Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.
* Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).
* Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey

**About Us**
============

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. At Foodstream, we are building the intelligence layer of food security, connecting people, data, and technology to move food faster, smarter, and more equitably. As a mission-driven, for-profit social enterprise, we use digital infrastructure to link the entire food recovery ecosystem, from donors and distributors to transportation providers and community organizations. Our work operates across two core verticals: Foodstream Learn, an NYC Department of Education–approved program that delivers food literacy and sustainability education in schools and Foodstream Network, which powers real-time food movement and impact tracking. Together, these platforms create a unified model that combines technology, education, and collaboration to reduce waste, expand access, and strengthen community resilience.

Location: New York City (Remote with regular onsite visits)

Compensation: $30 - $40 per hour, based on experience

FoodStream Learn is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Program Manager to oversee the strategic coordination and operational execution of our food education programs in NYC public schools. This leadership role involves supervising program staff and educators, managing school partnerships, ensuring program quality and compliance, and supporting program expansion. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, leader, and systems thinker with a track record in education or nonprofit program management.

* Curriculum Oversight: Collaborate with curriculum developers and educators to align content with school needs, DOE standards, and inclusive teaching practices.
* Monitoring & Evaluation: Lead data collection, impact reporting, and feedback processes to assess program effectiveness and areas for improvement.
* Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure programs meet health, safety, and quality guidelines; troubleshoot operational issues as needed.
* Strategic Development: Support grant reporting, partner communications, and long-term planning for program growth and sustainability.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Program Management, Public Health, or related field (Master’s preferred)
* 4+ years of experience in program management, school partnerships, or nonprofit operations

* Strong leadership, planning, and conflict resolution skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Comfort managing multiple projects and school relationships simultaneously

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with NYC public schools or DOE programming

* Part-time contract position with flexible scheduling based on school program needs and team oversight
* Hourly compensation of $30 - $40, based on experience and qualifications

**How to Apply**

Please submit your application via the job post. Thank you.

FoodStream Network (FSN) is a pioneering organization dedicated to transforming food access, education, and distribution through innovative programs and technology-driven solutions.

**About the Office of the City Administrator:**  
**The Office of the City Administrator**includes 20+ agencies and over 1,000 dedicated staff who provide essential services to San Francisco residents and businesses and improve the administration of government.  
  
**Our Mission**  
The City Administrator’s Office is strongly committed to ensuring efficient and effective government services, increasing the City’s safety and resiliency, strengthening the local economy, supporting equity and inclusion, and optimizing the City’s capital planning and infrastructure.

**Our Vision**

We are committed to ensuring that the City's services are inclusive, efficient, equitable, and culturally competent for San Franciscans of all races, ethnic backgrounds, religions, and sexual orientations. This commitment requires comprehensive review and thorough analysis of existing practices and policies to remove barriers to real inclusion.

We are also committed to ensuring that the Department is a safe, equitable, and inclusive workplace for individuals of all races. This includes creating opportunities for hiring, promotion, retention, training, and development, for all employees, including but not limited to Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC).

To learn more about our departments, divisions, and programs, visit: https://sf.gov/departments/city-administrator

**About the Government Operations Initiative:**

The Government Operations Initiative (GovOps) brings together teams across the City Administrator’s Office, Controller’s Office, and Department of Human Resources to tackle complex operational challenges that cut across traditional departmental boundaries. Launched in 2022 with an initial focus on supporting the City’s recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic, GovOps focuses on improving the systems, policies, and processes that underpin City operations, with a focus on procurement and contracting, hiring, and financial operations.

GovOps teams combine project management, policy and process expertise, data analysis, and change management to develop and implement complex reforms. Our work requires understanding how City processes operate today, identifying where they create unnecessary burden or barriers, and partnering across departments to design and implement practical improvements.

**The Procurement Reform Team**

The Senior Project Manager will join the GovOps Procurement Reform team within the City Administrator’s Office. Our team leads citywide efforts to make procurement and contracting simpler, faster, more effective, and more accessible for both the City staff who use these processes and the suppliers who do business with the City.

Our portfolio spans policy and legislative reform, business process redesign, technology modernization, data and performance, and improvements to the supplier experience. We take on complex problems that often cross organizational and functional boundaries, working from initial problem definition and research through design, implementation, change management, and evaluation.

While our core team is small, our work is highly collaborative. We partner closely with the Office of Contract Administration (OCA), Contract Monitoring Division (CMD), Department of Technology (DT), Controller’s Office (CON), and contracting professionals and operational teams across City departments.

In our work, we strive to be dynamic and responsive to City staff and supplier needs, and we are guided by questions such as:

* How can we make City processes simpler and more effective without losing the safeguards necessary for responsible stewardship of public resources?
* How can we reduce barriers for small and local businesses, community-based organizations, and other suppliers seeking to do business with the City?
* How do we design reforms that are ambitious enough to meaningfully improve government while also being practical, sustainable, and responsive to the people who will use them?

This role is an opportunity for someone who is motivated by convoluted but compelling challenges in governance, enjoys bringing order to ambiguity, and is interested in finding the right balance between incremental and transformational change. We are looking for someone who is committed to ensuring that public institutions serve communities equitably and sees themselves as a public-sector leader.

 **Job Description**

The Senior Project Manager will lead the team’s technology, policy, systems, data, and performance portfolio, driving complex initiatives that improve how the City purchases goods and services and how suppliers do business with the City. The role will have a particular focus on leveraging emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, modernizing procurement systems, and strengthening the use of data and performance management to improve City operations. As one of two GovOps team leads, this position will lead high-priority, cross-departmental projects from strategy and design through implementation and continuous improvement. The Senior Project Manager will report to the Deputy Director of Operations and Procurement Reform in the Office of Contract Administration.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Terra AI is building a new category at the intersection of artificial intelligence, geoscience, and critical resource development.

As global demand for copper, lithium, nickel, rare earth elements, geothermal energy, and other strategic resources accelerates, the mining and subsurface industries face a growing challenge: traditional exploration methods remain slow, expensive, and highly uncertain. Terra AI was founded to help solve this problem by redefining how critical resources are discovered, evaluated, and developed.

By combining advanced machine learning, probabilistic modeling, and deep geoscience expertise, Terra AI helps exploration and mining companies make faster, more informed subsurface decisions with greater confidence and capital efficiency. The company’s platform integrates geological, geophysical, and drilling data into intelligent systems designed to improve targeting accuracy, accelerate discovery timelines, and reduce exploration risk.

Backed by Khosla Ventures, BHP, and Rio Tinto, Terra AI works with industry leaders to bring a more informed, data-driven approach to critical resource development.

Terra AI’s mission is to define the new global standard for data-driven critical resource development — breaking the cost and time curve required to support electrification, energy security, and the global energy transition.

The company operates with a strong partnership mentality, combining technical rigor, candid communication, continual learning, and environmental stewardship to help modern exploration teams solve some of the world’s most important resource challenges.

**Who you are**
---------------

You’re a seasoned project manager who’s comfortable learning as you go. Experience has taught you what good looks like, where projects tend to break down, and when a little structure can prevent a lot of pain later.

Technical complexity doesn’t intimidate you. You’ve worked closely with scientists and engineers and can absorb complicated information deeply enough to ask good questions, connect the dots, and help teams make sound decisions. You know when a project needs flexibility and room to move—and when it’s time to bring in more structure, process, or discipline.

You are calm under pressure, and in front of high-value customers. You communicate clearly, exercise good judgment, own mistakes when they happen, and help create an environment where others can do the same.

Strong written and visual communication is part of the craft. You can write a paragraph at least as good as this one without the help of an LLM, and you have the editorial judgment to know when a document or slide deck is genuinely ready to present—or when it still needs another pass.

**What you’ll do**

This role sits at the center of our customer engagements, bringing together teams of geoscientists, software engineers, and AI/ML engineers to solve complex problems in projects that run for a few months at a time. The work is highly collaborative and varied—from early assessment and scoping through data review and processing, development of code and configurations, machine learning, and ultimately validating and tuning the results.

You will establish yourself as a trusted presence with our customers. Our projects involve high-value relationships around the world, with conversations happening both in person and remotely across time zones. Clear communication matters here, whether that means translating complex technical work for a broader audience, helping a teammate sharpen a presentation, or making sure everyone leaves a conversation with the same understanding of what comes next.

Keeping our projects moving takes equal parts organization, judgment, and curiosity. There are schedules and checklists to manage, decisions to make, changes to navigate, and moments when leadership needs to weigh in. But some of the most important contributions are less procedural: asking the question that helps a team see a problem differently, creating space for a better idea to emerge, helping people through an obstacle, and making sure great work gets recognized when the team succeeds.

We’ve built tools and processes to support this work, but we don’t consider any of them finished. There’s plenty of room to improve what exists, challenge how we do things today, and help build what comes next.

### **Core responsibilities**

* Serve as a primary point of contact across multiple overlapping client projects, owning day-to-day project management and helping ensure successful delivery
* Set and manage clear expectations with customers and internal teams throughout each engagement
* Build and maintain project plans covering scope, timelines, milestones, risks, decisions, and completion status
* Keep important information, decisions, and action items, from falling through the cracks, and make sure commitments are met
* Track project health and prioritize using both metrics and your expert judgment
* Help improve the playbooks, tools, and templates that allow us to run more client engagements in parallel without sacrificing quality
* Identify and manage risks and issues: bring the right people together to resolve them, and escalate thoughtfully when needed
* Plan and facilitate effective internal and customer meetings, with clear agendas, decisions, and next steps
* Create clear, polished customer-facing materials and help technical team members communicate their work effectively

### **Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in project management, technical program management, implementation, professional services, or a similar role
* Experience in a rapidly scaling startup environment is a strong plus
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers, ideally delivering software products or services to demanding clients
* Demonstrated ability to work closely with scientists and engineers, understanding enough underlying technology to ask good questions and drive great decisions
* Experience with software, AI

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

* Providing leadership in mentoring personnel, including reviewing their work for accuracy and clarity and providing constructive feedback on project tasks.

**Minimum** **Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental planning or related field.
* 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education in electric transmission and renewable energy (e.g., solar, wind, energy storage) through preparing CEQA and/or NEPA documents, routing and siting analysis, critical issues analysis, land use entitlement applications and/or overseeing multi-disciplinary technical teams for resource technical studies and permitting.
* A valid U.S. Driver's license is required for this role.
* Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience successfully managing and preparing CEQA and NEPA documentation, strong understanding of current state and federal regulations and guidance.
* Electric transmission and renewable energy (e.g., solar, wind, energy storage) experience through preparing CEQA and/or NEPA documents, routing and siting analysis, critical issues analysis, land use entitlement applications and/or overseeing multi-disciplinary technical teams for resource technical studies and permitting.
* Experience and relationships with California planning and resource agencies, and with processing project applications for land use entitlements.
* Experience leading licensing with the CPUC and other state transmission agencies.
* Experience leading NEPA and technical studies and other requirements of projects located on federal lands.
* Project management experience on environmental planning and permitting projects.
* Strong organizational skills, spreadsheet/document tracking skills, and an ability to work on several projects or issues simultaneously.

  
**Additional Information**  

* Sponsorship will not be provided

new_jobs.description:
**Project Manager | K-12 School Construction**

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

We are seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager with a strong background in California DSA regulated K-12 school construction to join an established commercial construction team delivering educational projects throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of school construction projects that directly impact local communities, students and educators. The ideal candidate brings hands on experience managing DSA projects, strong leadership skills and the ability to oversee project execution from preconstruction through final completion.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Manage all phases of K-12 school construction projects, from preconstruction through closeout.
* Oversee project budgets, schedules, cost forecasting, procurement and financial performance.
* Coordinate with school districts, owners, architects, engineers, subcontractors and inspectors.
* Ensure compliance with California DSA requirements, approved construction documents and applicable building codes.
* Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, meeting minutes and project documentation.
* Lead project meetings and maintain clear communication with project stakeholders.
* Monitor subcontractor performance, construction progress, quality control and safety.
* Identify potential project risks and develop solutions to keep projects on schedule and within budget.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, punch lists and final project closeout.
* Maintain accountability for project performance, client satisfaction and successful delivery.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience as a Project Manager within commercial general contracting.
* Direct experience managing California DSA regulated K-12 school construction projects.
* Strong knowledge of DSA procedures, inspection requirements and public school construction.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, subcontractors and owner relationships.
* Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications and contracts.
* Excellent communication, organization, problem solving and leadership skills.
* Experience with project management platforms such as Procore and Bluebeam is a plus.

**Compensation & Perks**
------------------------

* Competitive salary: Estimated base compensation of $130,000 to $165,000, depending on experience.
* Meaningful project work: Help deliver educational facilities that serve students, teachers and communities throughout the Bay Area.
* Project ownership: Take an active role in project execution, financial performance, scheduling and client relationships.
* Regional project exposure: Work on educational construction projects across a major Northern California market.
* Professional growth: Opportunity to continue building expertise in DSA regulated construction and expand project leadership responsibilities.
* Collaborative environment: Work closely with project teams, clients, design professionals and trade partners to deliver successful projects.

Additional benefits, including annual bonus, medical coverage, retirement contributions, vehicle allowance and paid time off, are to be confirmed.

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------

You are a proactive Project Manager who understands the complexities of California school construction and has a track record of successfully delivering DSA projects. You can manage competing priorities, build strong relationships with project stakeholders and take ownership of outcomes from start to finish.

If you have a background in DSA K-12 construction and are looking for an opportunity to contribute to impactful projects throughout the Bay Area, we'd like to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator- Richmond
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for start-up, control, and shut-down of product movements related to marine transfers and overseeing all typical terminal operations on a daily basis at Richmond Terminal. The position is responsible for coordinating operations activities within the Terminal and Phillips 66 Terminal regarding marine transfers. The position has primary responsibility for facility integrity for movements through Terminal piping-systems and storage tanks.

Responsibilities:

This position is the primary contact person for interfacing with Phillips 66/Richmond Terminal for the scheduling and coordinating of all marine related activities. The main contacts are with operations supervisors at the Phillips 66 Terminal. The position is also responsible for emergency response notification and is required to report to various government agencies in the event of an emergency.

The position operates by strict adherence to standard operating procedures and best management practices (BMP), which are based upon requirements set forth by the EPA, California State Lands Commission, USCG, OSPR, BAAQMD, POTW, Richmond Fire Department, Department of Transportation, etc.

* Establish field operations objectives and priorities on a daily basis to meet or exceed customer requirements on a daily basis - consulting with Area Manager and other Operations Coordinators as needed.
* Oversee the safe and environmentally correct transfer of products to and from the Terminal via all modes of transportation (tank-trucks, tank-cars, ocean going tankers, tank-to-tank transfers, blending, etc.).
* Effective communication and interaction with truck drivers, railroad personnel, marine vessel personnel, marine agents, internal/external customers, etc.
* Insure timely completion of all safety inspections required at the Terminal, and the filing of related documentation.
* Oversee staffing requirements related to field operations.
* Maintain an inventory of required operations and safety supplies, restocking as required. Also, working within a budget defined by the Area Manager.
* Maintain and oversee operating standards on a daily basis to ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures and all local, state and federal regulations.
* Conduct and participate in SOP, environmental, health and safety training of operators as required. Assure that operators adhere to the training schedule.
* Assist with facility inspections by various city, county, state and federal regulatory agencies, including BAAQMD, POTW, USCG, California State Lands Commission, OSPR, etc.
* Conduct a minimum of three security checks on arriving tank-trucks on a daily basis and document accordingly.
* Maintain records regarding storm water discharges.
* Maintain records regarding hazardous waste generated as a result of Terminal operations.
* Perform Customer Service Representative duties after hours when needed.
* Perform lab analysis of specific products during off-hours and weekends.

  
Qualifications:

**Minimum requirements:**

**Education:**

* High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

**Experience/specific Knowledge:**

* Two to four years related experience within the terminal industry is required.
* Knowledgeable of storage tank operations, piping-system operations, valves, pumping rates and pressures.
* Must be knowledgeable of all procedures affecting marine transfers and tank farm operations, including piping-system line-ups, operating rates and pressures, line control techniques, pump types and operation, and product characteristics.

**Certification, licenses, registrations:**

* A satisfactory driving record as determined by the Company and a current, valid State driver's license are required.
* If the employee is subject to license or certification requirements or training as stipulated by local, state or federal agencies or the Company, now or in the future, compliance is required under this job description.
* Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) required and is a condition of employment.

**Competencies, skills, and abilities:**

* The Operations Coordinator needs to be familiar with Richmond Terminal’s emergency response plans in order to initiate emergency response. Familiarity with product characteristics affecting emergency response is also required.
* The Operations Coordinator must be familiar with product specifications for all products stored at Richmond Terminal.
* Proficiency with computer applications, including Microsoft Excel, Word, Project, and Outlook.
* Well-balanced interpersonal skills and strong verbal and written communications skills are required.
* Must be accountable and take direction from Managers; keep required work schedules, which include regular and predictable job attendance; focus attention on details and follow work rules.
* Organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks are essential.
* Must be a problem solver with the ability to find resolutions.
* + Must be self-motivated and capable of working with minimal supervision and/or direction.
  + Must be flexible and able to work effectively in a team environment and consistently maintain a professional and respectful demeanor/attitude with co-workers, clients, vendors, and regulatory agencies.

**Physical demands:**

* Employee must be physically capable of completing and satisfying all training requirements as stipulated by local, state or federal agencies and/or Company Policy.
* Exposure to smells and fumes associated with refined petroleum products.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
CareMind Health is a captive clinical services entity of Mindoula Health, Inc., and a national provider of virtual psychiatry and comprehensive behavioral health care services. As a patient-centered organization, we are focused on supporting people with their mental health. We create access to convenient, high quality services delivered by compassionate and skilled clinicians. Our goal is to provide our clients with an exceptional experience that improves overall well-being, and restores the foundations of healthy living. We customize and scale these services to provide comprehensive behavioral health solutions for hospitals and other healthcare partners throughout the country. With expertise across the care continuum, we can not only fix pain points that many of our partners encounter - such as provider coverage gaps and ED throughput delays - but also solve complex problems that will improve patient experience, drive outcomes, and lower total cost of care.

We launched Mindoula because each of us had personal experience with mental illness, either directly or through a loved one. We realized that the behavioral health system was broken and decided to take it upon ourselves to fix it by focusing on the people we serve, not their diagnoses or symptom sets. Each of us, and everyone we serve, is a person first and a set of challenges second.

The ideal candidate will have an entrepreneurial spirit, strong clinical operational experience, and thrive in a high-growth environment. They will roll up their sleeves, hire, train and support clinicians, partnering with a cross-functional team, as we grow both our inpatient and outpatient practices.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Overall administrative & scheduling responsibilities to support the growing CareMind Inpatient practice.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to initiate clinical new hire requests (as budgeted or approved) and draft employment exhibits for new providers during the hiring process.
* Collaborate with the business development team on staffing models for new inpatient programs.
* Partner with CareMind leadership to interview and recruit new APPs to the practice for inpatient roles.
* Partner with the provider credentialing team to ensure new providers are ready for their projected start date with all required EMR access and training completed.
* Submit required paperwork to kick-off new provider credentialing (CAARFs), and submit off-boarding paperwork for providers exiting the practice.

* Create MD and APP staff schedules for all inpatient programs to be released at least 90-days in advance and work with the payroll team to ensure providers are paid accurately.

* Manage Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (“FPPE”) and Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (“OPPE”) processes for providers, including serving as proctor for reviews for APPs.
* In partnership with CareMind leadership, develop, manage, and ensure performance against practice outcome measures for CareMind overall and as required in specific contracts (e.g., including measure based care with PROMs).
* Coordinate with team members on new program and service rollouts to ensure timelines, deliverables, and communications are on track.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure appropriate monitoring and reporting on inpatient quality and performance, while supporting compliance with hospital service agreements and CareMind policies and procedures.
* Partner with colleagues, draft policies pertinent to provider operations to improve outcomes and increase efficiency of the CareMind practice.
* Work in a collegial and responsive manner with patients, clients, and colleagues to ensure high satisfaction with clinical services provided and facilitate client, patient and clinician retention.
