new_jobs.title: Operations Manager, Member Services (Knowledge Management)
new_jobs.description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Manager, Member Journey & Knowledge Management owns two primary outcomes: the health of the Member Services knowledge base, and a complete, accurate picture of the end-to-end member journey — its processes, policies, and pain points. The ability to own and influence both, are paramount to the role.

This role documents and maps how the member journey actually works today, keeps the knowledge base that describes it accurate and trustworthy, and uses both to identify where Product can meaningfully improve the member experience, from the perspective of efficiency/effectiveness as well as automation where possible.

This is a deep, focused ownership role. Success means the knowledge base is clean and trusted for both human and AI agents, the journey is fully mapped and understood end-to-end, and Product team has a clear, evidence-based view into where to invest next.

**What you'll do:**

**Knowledge Base Health & Governance**

* Own the OneImaging knowledge base as the single source of truth.
* Own knowledge content lifecycle: identify and remediate outdated, duplicate, conflicting, or orphaned content.
* Establish and maintain the governance framework for content ownership, review cycles, approvals, and retirement.
* Define and maintain knowledge architecture: taxonomy, tagging, and organization to keep content findable.
* Monitor knowledge health: accuracy, freshness, duplication, content gaps, and search effectiveness.
* Ensure content is structured to support both human agents and AI-enabled support tools.
* Build reporting and dashboards that give leadership ongoing visibility into knowledge base health.

**End-to-End Member Journey Processes & Policies**

* Own documentation of the full member journey encompassing every process and policy a member touches from first contact through resolution.
* Partner with Business Owners and Product SMEs to validate that documented processes reflect actual practice.
* Ensure that when a process or policy changes, it's reflected consistently across all documentation and the knowledge base.
* Build and maintain visual, end-to-end process maps of the member journey across systems, teams, and handoffs.

**Product Enablement for Member Journey Improvement**

* Serve as the Member Services voice into Product: translate journey pain points, knowledge gaps, and operational friction into clear product opportunities.
* Analyze journey data, member feedback, and knowledge base usage to identify where product changes would most improve the member experience.
* Maintain visibility into upcoming product changes that affect the member journey and assess their downstream impact on processes and knowledge.
* Partner with Product to validate that shipped changes improve the member experience as intended.

**About you:**

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years in knowledge management, business process management, or journey/process mapping — preferably within Digital Health, Health Insurance, Radiology, or Tech-Enabled Healthcare Services.
* Proven experience owning a knowledge base end-to-end, including governance practices (ownership, review cycles, accuracy standards, retirement).
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining process maps (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro) for complex, cross-functional workflows.
* Experience partnering with Product teams to translate operational or process insights into clear requirements or opportunities.
* Comfortable working without direct reports — able to drive outcomes by influencing SMEs, Product, and Operations partners.
* Experience with knowledge base and CRM/support platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Notion).
* Highly self-directed, with the ability to build governance and mapping standards from first principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in radiology, medical imaging, or diagnostic services — clinical coordination, patient access, or operations.
* Familiarity with radiology workflows: prior authorization, imaging order management, payer-specific protocols, provider network coordination.
* Experience structuring knowledge content for AI-enabled support tools.

**Who You Are**

A systems thinker who instinctively maps how work actually flows before trying to fix it.

* Treats a messy knowledge base or an undocumented process as something to solve, not just flag.
* Keeps the member at the center of every process, policy, and product conversation — always asking "what does this feel like for the person on the other end?"
* Believes affordable, transparent healthcare access matters, and wants their work to be part of how OneImaging delivers on that promise.
* Data-driven but human-centered: uses journey and knowledge data to find problems, and judgment to prioritize fixes.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.*

NH, NJ, NY, NC, OH, PA, RI, SC, TN, VA, WV)

*Looking to grow your career in a team that values support, collaboration, and development?*

At Capstone Mechanical, we believe empowered team members create exceptional customer experiences. If you enjoy bringing structure to complex projects, supporting your teammates, and making a meaningful impact, this could be a great fit for you.

We’re seeking a Project Coordinator (internally, BSA – Project Division) to help our project teams deliver consistent, high-quality results from project initiation through closeout. You’ll partner with Project Leads and cross-functional teams to keep documentation, schedules, permitting, and administrative processes moving forward.

About Capstone Mechanical

Since 2011, Capstone has delivered exceptional commercial HVAC/R service, maintenance, and installation to some of the nation’s top brands. Our mission is to build meaningful relationships - with our customers and with each other - by operating with care, transparency, and excellence.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

* Great Place to Work® Certified

* Culture rooted in trust, transparency, and growth

* Remote flexibility with collaborative team support

* Direct contribution to business results and team performance

What You’ll Accomplish

As a BSA – Project Division, you’ll support Project Leads and help ensure projects run smoothly from initiation through closeout. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

* Maintain accurate, organized project documentation across software platforms and track key milestones, deliverables, and deadlines.

* Assist with project closeout documentation and timely, accurate payroll submissions for Project Leads.

* Process and verify invoices with the GM of Projects; review quotes and finalize invoice submissions.

* Coordinate with municipalities, engineers, and property owners to apply for, secure, and close out permits; maintain municipal relationships and meet requirements.

* Coordinate project and team calendars for site access, surveys, crane lifts, installations, deliveries, vendors, and inspections.

* Work with the team to secure resources needed for project completion and serve as an administrative point of contact for Project Leads.

* Communicate project status and schedules to internal and external stakeholders and collaborate across the Project Division, Service Teams, and administrative departments.

* Immediately escalate safety concerns.

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, documentation, and coordination; maintain SOPs that support scalable growth.

* Participate in training and professional development to strengthen skills and effectiveness.

What We’re Looking For

You may be a great fit if you are:

* Customer-Focused – You care about delivering a great experience

* **Organized & Detail-Oriented** – You can manage multiple projects, timelines, and documentation requirements.

  **Collaborative** – You communicate clearly with Project Leads, municipalities, vendors, and internal teams.

  **Proactive & Adaptable** – You anticipate needs, solve problems, and adjust as project priorities change.

  **Accountable** – You follow through on deadlines and take ownership of accurate work.

  **Improvement-Minded** – You look for ways to simplify processes and help the team grow.

Basic Requirements:

* + Experience in project coordination, permitting, or administrative support in construction, HVAC, or a related field.
  + Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  + Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management platforms such as Basecamp, SharePoint, or FieldPoint.
  + Understanding of basic project financial processes, including invoicing and payroll submissions.
  + High attention to detail and the ability to analyze data, interpret metrics, and make informed decisions.

Our Benefits & Perks

* + Competitive Hourly Compensation
  + PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave
  + Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  + Wellness Program with premium discounts
  + 100% Company-paid Short & Long-Term Disability + $25K Life Insurance
  + Additional Life Insurance Options for employee, spouse, and children
  + 401(k) with 3% Employer Contribution
  + Bi-Annual Bonus Program
  + Free Financial Advising
  + Employee Assistance Program for mental, financial, and legal support
  + Personal and Professional Development Opportunities

Ready to build your career with a company that invests in you?  
Apply today and be part of something meaningful.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER  
Capstone Mechanical is an equal employment opportunity employer. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws in providing our employees and applicants with equal opportunity. Our decisions and criteria governing the employment relationship with all employees are non-discriminatory and are based on job requirements and an individual’s skills and experience without regard to race, creed, color, gender (including pregnancy), religion, age, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, veteran status, disability, gender identity or expression, or any other status protected by state or federal law. All matters related to employment are based upon the ability to perform the job, plus dependability and reliability once hired.

new_jobs.description:

In this role, you will be the voice of our practice—answering high-volume incoming phone calls, guiding potential clients with care, scheduling consultations, routing calls to the appropriate team members, and maintaining our attorneys' schedules.

Because of the personal nature of our work, you must blend exceptional phone presence and organization with genuine warmth and patience.

This is a full-time role, Monday - Friday, 8:30 a.m.- 5:00 pm Eastern Time.

**Location Requirement:** Must currently reside in **Pennsylvania** or **Nevada** (Required for state tax and employment purposes).

 **Compensation:**

$18 - $22 hourly

 **Responsibilities:**

* **First Impressions:** Answer high-volume incoming calls promptly with a welcoming, friendly, and professional tone.
* **Client Intake & Compassionate Listening:** Gather preliminary information from prospective clients, showing empathy and patience while ensuring they feel heard and valued.
* **Scheduling & Calendar Management:** Schedule initial consultations, client meetings, and attorney callbacks accurately across multiple time zones using our practice management software.
* **Call Routing & Message Taking:** Route incoming calls to attorneys, paralegals, or staff members efficiently, taking detailed and accurate messages when team members are unavailable.
* **Vendor & Solicitor Screening:** Gratefully and firmly screen sales and solicitor calls, keeping our phone lines open for clients while politely conveying that the firm is not interested.
* **Administrative Support:** Assist with pre-consultation follow-up emails, basic data entry, and updating client information in our CRM/case management system.

 **Qualifications:**

* **Location Requirement:** Must currently reside in **Pennsylvania** or **Nevada** (Required for state tax and employment purposes).
* **Phone Experience:** At least 2+ years of high-volume phone handling, front-desk, customer service, or call-center experience (experience in a law firm, medical office, or professional service firm is a major plus).
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a clear, calm, and reassuring telephone voice.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Comfortable using cloud-based VoIP phone systems, electronic calendar systems (Google Calendar), CRM software, and basic office applications.
* **Empathy & Tact:** Ability to navigate sensitive situations (such as recent family passings or elderly care concerns) with grace, confidentiality, and respect.
* **Remote Workspace:** A quiet, private home office free from background noise, equipped with high-speed internet and a reliable computer setup.

* Provide exceptional legal services with dedication and compassion
* Empower individuals to safeguard their Life and preserve their Legacy
* Communicate promptly and clearly

* Help you navigate complex legal matters with confidence
* Support your present peace of mind and future security
* Deliver a thoughtful, client-centered experience every step of the way

new_jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Our Mission:**

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

**Our People:**

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

**About the Role**

6sense is hiring a **Senior Digital Program Manager** to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform. Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

**What This Role Is – And Isn't**

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

* **You move fast and ship.** Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.
* **You lead, not just execute.** You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.
* **You flag blockers immediately.** Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.
* **You own your backlog.** You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.
* **You know the difference between "I need input" and "I need permission."** Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Program Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
* Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.
* Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.
* Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.
* Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

**Digital Journey & Campaign Build**

* Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.
* Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.
* Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.
* A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

**Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis**

* Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.
* Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.
* Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

**Gainsight Platform** **Leader**

* Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.
* Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs
* Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

**Reporting, Analytics & Insights**

* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership
* Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.
* Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

**CS Ops & Leadership Partnership**

* Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.
* Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.
* Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).
* Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey

Imagine working at the forefront of technology in mission-critical buildings/infrastructures industries, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence of nearly 100 years that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that improve energy efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and support the infrastructure our communities depend on every day. Every contribution helps lower global carbon footprints and brings us closer to a cleaner, more resilient future. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business, one that’s making our cities, and the world, more sustainable.

  

As a **Regional Key Account Manager**, you will be responsible for executing global account strategies within a designated geographic region by engaging with regional client teams, identifying regional opportunities and working closely with key internal stakeholders to drive strong sales performance and deep adoption of our technology within the account, through valuer articulation around energy efficiency, carbon abatement, and space optimization.

* Build and nurture trusted relationships with regional account decisionmakers including senior executives and operational leaders.

* Create account-specific action plans including the identification of local sales opportunities and areas for technology adoption.
* Collaborate with the MPS (Modular Products and Solutions) offering team and other product Offering Managers to develop or adapt solutions for the unique needs of customers.

* Collaborate closely with the Global Key Accounts Manager (GKAM) during regional visits, joint customer meetings, and strategic negotiations to ensure consistency and alignment.

* Tailor the global “LAMP” plan for assigned Global accounts at the regional level by adapting key initiatives to the local market context.

new_jobs.title: Technical Enablement Manager, Identity Security
new_jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

The Technical Enablement Manager will provide SE leaders, SEs, and our channel partners with the learning materials, content, and resources to win in identity security. As identity becomes the control point for how people, machines and AI agents access enterprise data, our field teams need deep fluency in identity security concepts, our product differentiation, and how to position it with CISOs and identity and access management leaders. Partnering with the sales, product and technical leadership teams as well as the broader enablement team, the technical enablement lead will develop and execute impactful programs for up-leveling the technical and non-technical skills of the pre-sales teams. A successful technical enablement lead will scale and improve programs as well as support new programs from conception to adoption. Success is measured by the overall business impact of these programs.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Work with pre-sales, channel, product and technical leadership to develop, execute, optimize and assess enablement programs for the identity security portfolio
* Determine identity security enablement priorities with pre-sales stakeholders
* Communicate enablement strategy and KPIs to stakeholders
* Build a trusted relationship with channel, pre-sales reps and leaders
* Serve as a liaison between pre-sales and product teams, translating identity security product releases and customer use cases into field-ready messaging
* Provide effective onboarding and training programs for pre-sales, including hands-on labs and demos covering IAM, PAM, IGA and non-human identity use cases
* Coordinate educational content for ongoing training
* Build and maintain identity security learning paths and certification programs, including ITDR and AI agent identity
* Facilitate content creation and use with pre-sales teams, including identity security demos, battlecards and technical collateral
* Gather and relay feedback to continuously iterate on overall enablement strategy
* Use performance data to identify identity security knowledge or skill gaps across the sales team
* Contribute to GTM strategy and planning for identity security
* Track identity security market trends and competitors, and turn them into positioning and training for the field

  
Requirements:  
  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5+ years experience in a high-performance cybersecurity sales organization in sales, sales engineering, pre-sales, channel, enablement, or learning and development
* A strong understanding of Enterprise security pre-sales, including developing technical sales content, demos, labs and training from the ground up
* Working knowledge of identity security concepts, including IAM, IGA, PAM, SSO and MFA, identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and Zero Trust
* Familiarity with non-human and AI agent identities, service accounts, secrets management and least-privilege access models
* Experience with content management and learning management systems, ideally in an Enterprise first selling motion
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex identity security concepts to technical and executive audiences
* Security or identity certifications (such as CISSP, Security+ or vendor certifications) are a plus
* Ability to work with ambiguity in an unstructured, high growth and fast paced environment

**﻿**

**COMPENSATION INFORMATION:**

Compensation Range: $130,000-$160,000

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

**﻿BENEFITS - Why Cyera?**

* Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid holidays and sick time
* Health, vision, and dental insurance
* Life, short and long-term disability insurance

**Summary**  
  
**Seasonal Technical Support Agents** are on the front line helping Greenshades customers navigate our payroll, HR, and tax software during our year-end peak season. You will resolve issues efficiently, deliver exceptional service, and ensure clients feel supported and confident in using our solutions. This is a fast-paced, high-volume role where attention to detail, empathy, and problem-solving skills are key.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Frontline Support: Provide responsive, professional support via phone, email, and live chat for payroll, year-end tax filings, and software troubleshooting.
* Issue Resolution: Accurately log, triage, and resolve support cases in a timely manner, escalating when appropriate.
* Training & Walkthroughs: Guide clients through workflows, including year-end processes, either ad hoc or in scheduled sessions.
* Customer Satisfaction: Maintain a positive and empathetic approach to reduce customer frustration during high-stress year-end periods.
* Collaboration: Work closely with peers and leads to identify trends, share best practices, and improve support processes.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Technical Aptitude: Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software platforms quickly (experience with SaaS, payroll, tax, or HR systems a plus).
* Customer Service Experience: 1+ years in technical support, call center, or customer service role (high-volume environment).
* Communication Skills: Clear, professional phone presence and excellent written skills (grammar, spelling, tone).
* Problem Solving: Ability to troubleshoot common software issues, guide users through workflows, and de-escalate frustrated clients.
* Reliability: Must have consistent, high-speed internet and a distraction-free environment for taking calls.
* Self-Starter: Dependable, organized, and able to manage workload with minimal supervision.
* Flexibility: Availability to work extended hours, evenings, and weekends as needed during year-end peak.

**What We Offer**

* Seasonal role (typically November – February, with potential extension).
* Paid training on Greenshades software and year-end processes.
* Remote work with flexible shifts to cover high-volume periods.
* Opportunity to gain experience supporting mission-critical payroll and tax processes at scale.

Ideal Candidate Profile: You thrive in high-energy, fast-paced environments. You are calm under pressure, love helping customers, and enjoy solving problems. You have prior experience in technical support or payroll/tax season roles and are excited about being part of a team that helps businesses close out their year successfully. You are aligned with our Core Values of Trust, Accountability, Ruthless Prioritization, Urgency & Impact.

This is a remote position.
